notes: The state parameter omission in 3.2 is subtle—a quick review might miss that OpenID Connect requires both state and nonce.

90-day session duration (3.4) contradicts the 30-day maximum in security policy.
JWKS refresh issue (3.5.1) requires checking providers-config.yaml to see the 24-hour refresh requirement.

Some items like the state parameter byte size (3.5.2) are lower severity but show attention to detail.
